title: Library Interface Definition
description: Schema for validating Library Interface definitions that establish semantic component standards

description.description: Clear description of the interface's purpose and domain scope

category.description: Domain category (e.g., marketing, documentation, ecommerce) that groups related interfaces

version.description: Semantic version of the interface following SemVer convention (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH)

components.description: Set of semantic components defined by this interface

description.description: Clear description of the component's communication purpose

category.description: Semantic category within the interface for grouping related components

presets.description: Named preset variations representing different content approaches for this component

additionalProperties.description: Description of the preset's specific content purpose

metadata.description: Optional additional metadata about the component
Optional additional metadata about the interface

Hero.description: Primary attention-grabbing section at the top of a page that sets the tone and focus

presets.brand: Emphasizes company identity, values, and overall brand positioning
presets.product: Focuses on product value proposition, features, and benefits
presets.campaign: Highlights special campaign, promotion, or time-sensitive offering
presets.minimal: Presents streamlined, text-focused messaging without complex visual elements

Features.description: Highlights product or service features and capabilities to communicate value

presets.benefits: Communicates value-focused outcomes that customers gain
presets.capabilities: Showcases technical abilities and functional aspects
presets.process: Illustrates sequential steps or workflow showing how something operates
